text:
elaine.growth: heads-up — seeing ~2% of HubSpot -> SFDC handoffs fail to land in RR when enrichment latency spikes >6s. some leads sit unassigned for 30m and then backfill. noticed this after last weekend webinar.
jamal.ops: ack. are we sure it's enrichment blocking the handshake vs webhook retries? logs? :thinking_face:
elaine.growth: sample trace attached in alerts channel earlier but quick repro: hs webhook returns 202, enrichment pipeline (external enrich) sometimes takes 8–12s, our router waits for enrichment TTL=5s then routes to fallback queue which isn't picked up by claim workers.
sara.marketing: this explains increased manual claims from SDRs. can we add an interim "gateway" queue that holds leads for 1m to let enrichment finish? low-risk toggle in workflows.
mike.salesops: pragmatic: 1) set HS workflow to forward to gateway queue (low priority) instead of immediate RR 2) router polls gateway and prefers leads with enrichment flag 3) heartbeat to move leads back to RR if enriched >60s
jamal.ops: agree. quick patch idea: keep canonical RR but add a small delay-channel. also add circuit-breaker that bumps TTL if enrich service reports "in-progress". simple hubspot webhook payload example below: 
```json
{
  "event": "new_lead",
  "lead_id": "{{lead.id}}",
  "enrich_status": "pending",
  "received_at": "{{timestamp}}"
}
```
elaine.growth: can marketing add tag so SDRs can filter gateway leads in their queue? prefer not to increase noise. maybe auto-assign owner = unassigned and send digest.
olivia.eng: I can ship a router-side quickfix today — add a GatewayQueue consumer and a one-line rule: if lead.enrich_status != "done" then hold for up to 60s, re-check every 5s. fallback to existing RR after 60s. will open PR against dedicated routing service.
jamal.ops: please also add metrics: gauge for gateway_length, enrichment_wait_ms histogram, and alert if >1% leads >60s.
mike.salesops: Can we also update HubSpot workflow rule: if external enrich returns success then set property `enrich_status = done` and call `/router/webhook`? I'll draft change and post XML snippet.
sara.marketing: timeline? we want this before next big webinar.
olivia.eng: will open PR now, aim for deploy in 3pm PT canary. jamal — can you coordinate HS workflow change and QA with sales ops?
jamal.ops: Yep, I'll do HS side and coordinate with SDR leads. tagging @lead-router-bot to post deployment status.
lead-router-bot: deploy queued: routing-gateway-v1 by olivia.eng — status pending. :construction:
elaine.growth: thanks team — once deployed we'll monitor claim rates and SDR manual claims. add note to playbook about gateway flag so ops/sdrs know to ignore transient holds. :white_check_mark:
